note: Cartas do OP18 como saem do Cardkaizoku (cards) e do optcgleaks (optcgleaks, só as de texto diferente), baixadas em 29/10/2026, e cartas de apoio (Líderes Spandam OP18-079, Marshall.D.Teach OP09-081 e Nefeltari Vivi OP04-001).

cards.name: Karoo
cards.text:
Apply each of the following effects based on this Character's power:
• If it is 5000 or more, this Character gains [Rush].
• If it is 6000 or more, this Character gains [Banish].
• If it is 7000 or more, this Character gains [Unblockable].

cards.name: Kung Fu Jugon
cards.text: [Your Turn] This Character gains +1000 power for each of your [Kung Fu Jugon] Characters.

cards.name: Koza
cards.text: If you have a [Nefertari Vivi], this Character gains [Rush] and +1000 power.

cards.name: Chaka
cards.text:
If your Leader has the {Alabasta} type, this Character gains [Rush].
[On Play] You may trash 1 Character card with 5000 power or less from your hand: Draw 2 cards and this Character gains [Banish] during this turn.

cards.name: Pincers
cards.text: [When Attacking] Up to 1 of your Characters with both the {Animal} and {Alabasta} types gains +1000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Portgas.D.Ace
cards.text: [When Attacking] Up to 1 of your {Alabasta} type Characters gains [Rush] during this turn.

cards.name: Quaaack!!!
cards.text:
[Main] If you do not have a Character with a base power of 7000 or more, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters -3000 power during this turn.
[Counter] Your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle.

cards.name: Stop Fighting!
cards.text: [Counter] You may add all of your Life cards to your hand: If your Leader is [Nefertari Vivi], give your opponent's Leader and all of your opponent's Characters -5000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Gaimon
cards.text: [On Play] Up to 1 of your {East Blue} type Leaders or Characters gains [Banish] during this turn.

cards.name: Sanji
cards.text: If one of your {Straw Hat Crew} type Characters would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may trash this Character instead.

cards.name: Zoro & Sogeking
cards.text:
[Opponent's Turn] If your [Monkey.D.Luffy] Leader has 3 DON!! cards attached and is active, set its base power to 7000.
[On Play] Set up to 2 of your DON!! cards as active. Then, up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less cannot be rested until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Nami
cards.text: [Opponent's Turn] If this Character is rested, this Character gets -2000 power.

cards.name: Shoot Down That Flag
cards.text: [Main] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 [Sogeking] or {Straw Hat Crew} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Gum-Gum Giant Axe
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of [Monkey.D.Luffy] gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, if your Leader is active, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Hack
cards.text:
[On K.O.] Draw 1 card.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to 1 of your {Dressrosa} type Leader or Character cards.

cards.name: Mr Prince
cards.text:
Under the rules of this game, also treat this card's name as [Sanji].
This Character gains +1000 power for every 5 Event cards in your trash.

cards.name: Mr.0 & Ms. All Sunday
types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
cards.text:
[On Play] Draw 2 cards and give up to 2 rested DON!! cards to your Leader and all of your Characters.
[On Opponent's Attack] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Your Leader with a type including "Baroque Works" becomes 7000 base power during this turn.

cards.name: Mr.1(Daz.Bonez)
cards.text: [On Play] Your Leader with the {Cross Guild} type or a type including "Baroque Works" gains [Unblockable] during this turn.

cards.name: Mr.2.Bon.Kurei(Bentham)
cards.text: [On Play] You may look at 5 cards from the top of your deck and add up to 1 {Baroque Works} type card to your hand, then place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, you may attach up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.

cards.name: Mr.4 & Miss.MerryChristmas
cards.text:
DON!! x1 This Character gains +1000 power.
[On Play] You may rest 5 of your DON!! cards: Place up to 1 Character with a cost of 6 or less and up to 1 Character with a cost of 5 or less at the bottom of the owner's deck in any order of the owner's choosing.

cards.name: Atomic Dicer
cards.text:
[Main] You may rest 3 DON!! cards: Return up to 1 Character with a cost of 5 or less to the owner's hand.
[Counter] Your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle.

cards.name: I Pray For Your Success!
types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
cards.text:
[Main] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards and trash 1 {Baroque Works} type card from your hand: Draw 2 cards.
[Counter] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +3000 power during this battle.

cards.name: Saint Killingham
cards.text:
[Your Turn] [On Play] DON!! -1: Up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with an original power of 7000 or less and up to 1 Character with an original power of 5000 or less cannot attack until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
[On K.O.] DON!! -1: Play this Character from your trash.

cards.name: Senor Pink
cards.text:
[Once Per Turn] If this Character would be K.O.'d, you may DON!! -1 instead.
[On Play] DON!! -1: Up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 7 or less cannot be rested until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

cards.name: Trebol
cards.text:
If one of your {Donquixote Pirates} type Characters would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may return 1 DON!! card from your field to your DON!! deck instead.
[Opponent's Turn] If your Leader is [Sugar], this Character gains +2000 power and [Blocker].

cards.name: Franky Family
cards.text:
[Blocker]
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may K.O. 1 of your Stages with a cost of 5 or less: If this Character was played during this turn, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters -3000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Thousand Sunny
cards.text:
[On Play] Draw 1 card and add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck as rested.
[Activate: Main] DON!! -2 You may rest this Stage: Set up to 1 of your {Straw Hat Crew} type Characters with 7000 power or less as active.

cards.name: White Hobby Horse
cards.text:
[On Play] Draw 1 card and add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck as rested.
[Activate: Main] You may rest this Stage: Up to 1 of your {Straw Hat Crew} type Characters gains [Rush: Character] during this turn.

cards.name: Van Augur
cards.text:
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you trash a card from the effect of your [Marshall D. Teach] Leader, if you do not have any other [Van Augur], draw 1 card.
[On K.O.] Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Oars
cards.text: If you have a [Gecko Moria] Character, this Character gains [Double Attack] and [Blocker].
cards.trigger: Play up to 1 {Thriller Bark Pirates} type Character card with a cost of 4 or less from your trash rested.

cards.name: Catarina Devon
cards.text:
[When Attacking] This Character's base power becomes equal to your opponent's Leader's power during this turn.
[On K.O.] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If your Leader has the {Blackbeard Pirates} type, play this Character card from your trash rested.

cards.name: Saint Killingham
cards.text:
[Your Turn] [On Play] Play up to 1 [Sleeptids] from your trash.
[On K.O.] You may trash 2 cards from your hand: Play this Character.

cards.name: Gunko
cards.text:
[On Play] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 card with the {Holy Knights of God} type and add it to your hand. Then, place the remaining cards into the trash.
[Activate: Main] You may rest 4 of your DON!! cards: Play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 6 or less and the {Holy Knights of God} type from your trash.

cards.name: Cerberus
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may return this Character to the owner's hand: Up to 1 of your [Saint Shamrock] Characters gains [Rush], [Banish], or [Unblockable] during this turn.

cards.name: Stansen
cards.text:
This Character gains +12 cost.
If all of your Characters have a cost of 12 or more, this Character gains +2000 power.

cards.name: Kaku
cards.text: [On Play] Place up to 1 card with a type including "CP" from your hand to the top or bottom of your Life cards face-up.
cards.trigger: If your Leader has a type including "CP", draw 1 card and place up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 8 or less at the bottom of the owner's deck.

cards.name: Kumadori
cards.text: [On K.O.] Add up to 1 card with a type including "CP" from your hand to the top or bottom of your Life cards face-up.
cards.trigger: If your Leader's type includes "CP", K.O. or rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less.

cards.name: Spandam
cards.trigger: If your Leader has a type including "CP", reveal up to 1 card with a type including "CP" other than [Spandam] from your hand and activate the [Trigger] effect of that card.

cards.name: Nero
cards.text: [Blocker]
cards.trigger: If your Leader has a type including "CP", place up to 1 Character with a cost of 5 or less at the bottom of the owner's deck.

cards.name: Fukurou
cards.text: [Blocker]
cards.trigger: If your Leader has a type including "CP9", you may K.O. or rest up to 1 Character with a cost of 6 or less.

cards.name: Buster Call
cards.text: [Main] You may trash all of your Life cards: If your Leader is [Spandam], trash all Characters and play up to 5 {Vice Admiral} type Character cards with different card names from your deck or trash. Then, shuffle your deck.

support.text:
Your [On Play] effects are negated.
[Activate: Main] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Your opponent's [On Play] effects are negated until the end of your opponent's next turn.
